assumptions: All graphs and digraphs are finite and simple unless the statement explicitly says otherwise.

definitions.definition: An induced odd cycle of length at least 5.
A clique whose cardinality equals the clique number ω(G), not merely an inclusion-maximal clique.
All vertices of the set receive the same color.

quantifiers.domain: nonempty finite simple graphs with no induced odd cycle of length at least 5
vertex colorings c:V(G)→{1,2} for which every maximum clique uses both colors

statement.text: Does every nonempty finite simple graph with no induced odd cycle of length at least 5 admit a 2-coloring of its vertices in which no maximum clique is monochromatic?

title: Two-coloring without a monochromatic maximum clique
